title.en: Add SmartLingo colleges and unified course access labels
title.zh: 增加 SmartLingo 学院并统一课程访问标签

purpose.en: Adapt the verified SmartClass college release through source commit f110278 for SmartLingo while preserving its fixed language-course catalog, subscription model, and independent infrastructure.
purpose.zh: 把截至源提交 f110278 已验证的 SmartClass 学院版本适配到 SmartLingo，同时保留其固定语言课程目录、订阅模型与独立基础设施。

en: Add Choose College navigation, a home Colleges section before Courses, six-digit entry, Browse colleges, and My colleges.
Add searchable college discovery with General, Finance, Lifestyle, and Sports tags plus Open, Referred, and Private access filters.
Seed four SmartLingo colleges, each with its own price policy, automatic introductory course, and course table.
Let the permanent administrator create colleges and tags, update college access and pricing, and add existing SmartLingo courses to a college.
Use Open course / 公开课程, Referred course / 推荐课程, Private course / 专属课堂 and the matching college labels.
zh: 增加“选择学院”导航及位于课程区之前的首页学院区，支持六位编号进入、浏览学院和我的学院。
增加学院搜索、通用/金融/生活方式/体育标签，以及公开、推荐、专属访问筛选。
预置四个 SmartLingo 学院；每个学院都有独立价格策略、自动导论课程和课程表。
永久管理员可创建学院与标签、更新学院访问和价格，并把现有 SmartLingo 课程加入学院。
统一使用 Open course / 公开课程、Referred course / 推荐课程、Private course / 专属课堂及对应学院标签。

en: Home and shared navigation
College directory, detail, and create routes
Administrator dashboard and college-tag API
Course detail, enrollment, and classroom entitlement
D1 migration 0150 and Project release report
zh: 首页与共享导航
学院目录、详情与创建路由
管理员面板与学院标签 API
课程详情、加入与课程教室权益
D1 迁移 0150 与 Project 发布日报

en: Add site-owned college, tag, assignment, and college-course tables without importing SmartClass runtime code or data.
Create a subject introduction atomically with every new college and keep later course assignments independent.
Place the flexible college-number edit box left of the localized Enter button at every supported viewport.
Extend subject-course enrollment so Open courses join free and Referred courses use their configured trial days before payment.
Expand the bilingual WebKit release matrix from 230 to 260 combinations to cover college browse, detail, and create pages.
zh: 增加站点独立的学院、标签、标签分配和学院课程表，不导入 SmartClass 运行时代码或数据。
每次创建学院时原子创建一门学科导论课程，后续课程分配继续保持独立。
在所有支持视口中，学院编号输入框位于左侧，本地化“进入”按钮位于右侧。
扩展学科课程加入逻辑：公开课程免费加入，推荐课程按配置天数体验后再付款。
把中英文 WebKit 发布矩阵从 230 组扩展到 260 组，覆盖学院浏览、详情与创建页面。

en: Shared policy, architecture, base-feature consistency, and portfolio contract gates pass.
The production build, sensitive-data scan, artifact validation, and all repository tests pass.
The WebKit runtime layout matrix passes 260/260 combinations across 26 routes, two languages, and five phone, iPad, and desktop viewports.
zh: 共享规则、架构、基础功能一致性及全站合约门禁通过。
生产构建、敏感数据扫描、产物验证及全部仓库测试通过。
WebKit 运行时布局矩阵 260/260 通过，覆盖 26 条路由、两种语言及五种手机、iPad 与桌面视口。

en: This portfolio migration does not run cross-site live RealtimeKit browser sessions; existing SmartLingo realtime contracts remain automated and unchanged.
zh: 本次跨站迁移不执行跨站 RealtimeKit 实时浏览器会话；SmartLingo 现有实时合约继续由自动测试覆盖且未改变。

en: Unlike SmartClass Supervisor creation, SmartLingo college and tag creation remains permanent-administrator-only and reuses its site-owned fixed language courses.
SmartLingo keeps its locale-prefixed routes, independent D1/R2, Clerk, RealtimeKit, OpenAI/DeepSeek, payment, GitHub, and Cloudflare boundaries.
zh: 不同于 SmartClass Supervisor 创建方式，SmartLingo 的学院与标签创建仍仅限永久管理员，并复用本站独立的固定语言课程。
SmartLingo 保留语言前缀路由及独立 D1/R2、Clerk、RealtimeKit、OpenAI/DeepSeek、支付、GitHub 与 Cloudflare 边界。
